process_pdf.intro_paragraph_1: This document constitutes a formal technical certification of a digital voting process conducted using the Vocdoni Protocol. It establishes a structured, verifiable, and auditable record of the process configuration, eligible participant set (electoral census), turnout, and final results (tally). Its purpose is to enable independent auditors and authorized third parties to assess the integrity, consistency, and correct execution of the process.
process_pdf.intro_paragraph_2: All relevant data associated with this voting process has been recorded and anchored in publicly auditable records using the Vocdoni Protocol. These records ensure transparency, immutability, and end-to-end verifiability, while preserving voter anonymity and ballot confidentiality through cryptographic mechanisms.
process_pdf.intro_paragraph_3: This certification is issued exclusively by the technical service provider to attest to the correctness of the system execution and the integrity of the recorded data. It does not replace, supersede, or constitute any form of legal certification, nor does it assert compliance with jurisdiction-specific legal or regulatory requirements.

issuer.paragraph: Issued on behalf of the organizing entity in its role as technical service provider.

verification.paragraph: All process data has been recorded on a blockchain-based infrastructure and may be independently verified through the following public explorer:
verification.step_1: Open the verification explorer link of each question. Each page contains the public technical record of that part of the voting process.
verification.step_2: Check that each linked page shows the same question and choices as this report. This confirms that the report refers to the same on-chain voting processes.
verification.step_4: Check that the number of recorded ballots matches the participation data shown in this report.
verification.step_5: Compare the final tally in the explorer with the ballot-count or weighted voting-power results shown in this report.
verification.step_6: For a deeper technical audit, an auditor may inspect the public records in more detail or recompute the tally to confirm that the recorded ballots and final results are consistent.

voting_system.guarantee_lead: The Vocdoni Protocol increases trust in the voting process by providing:
voting_system.paragraph_1: The voting process was conducted using the Vocdoni Protocol, a digital voting protocol designed to create, execute, record, and verify voting processes with strong integrity guarantees.
voting_system.paragraph_2: When a voting process is created, its configuration is recorded on the blockchain before voting begins, creating a public and auditable record of how the process is intended to work. This includes the voting period, the voting method, the eligible participant set, the questions, and the rules that determine how results are counted. The census defines who is allowed to participate in the process, while preserving the privacy of individual voters.
voting_system.paragraph_3: During the voting period, eligible voters authenticate according to the configured method and submit their ballots through the voting system. The protocol is designed so that the process can be verified end to end.
voting_system.paragraph_4: Once the voting process is completed, the final results and the relevant process records are anchored in the blockchain. This makes the process auditable and helps ensure that the published report can be compared against public technical records.

aguicat.company: Associació de Guies Habilitats de Catalunya
aguicat.text: Setting up the entire voting process and centralizing all the tools for the assembly was easy, intuitive, and clear. Even in a sector that is not very tech-savvy, we got strong participation - people especially valued being able to vote in advance without attending in person.

arxivers.text: Offering members a secure and reliable voting system is essential, especially during a pandemic. Vocdoni gave us an easy-to-use tool that simplified the voting process and boosted participation.

ati.text: As Associazione Termotecnica Italiana, Friuli Venezia Giulia section, we chose to digitize our governance to make it easier for professionals to participate. Vocdoni stood out as the ideal solution for its simplicity, costs, and guarantees.

bellpuig.text: We chose Vocdoni because we believe this is the future of what real elections of any kind should be. Electronic voting is open to everyone and makes the voting process easier for citizens.

bisbal.text: Vocdoni powered our Bisbalenc/a de l'Any vote, boosting citizen participation and delivering transparency, security, and instant results on blockchain. We valued its security, scalability, universal verifiability, and flexibility.

ceec.text: We chose Vocdoni because it guarantees secure, reliable, and transparent participation for all our members in our Annual General Meeting.

coib.company: Official College of Nurses of Barcelona
coib.text: At the Official College of Nurses of Barcelona, we trust Vocdoni for all our participatory processes, ensuring members can exercise their rights from anywhere. We especially value the immediate vote count, the simplicity of the system, and the fast, effective response and guidance from its technical support, which makes the entire process agile, transparent, and reliable.

eic.text: Vocdoni provides us with an easy, secure, anonymous, scalable voting system that is fully integrated into our institutional environment. We will certainly continue to trust their solution.

erc.position: National Secretary of Membership, Anti-repressive Struggle and Emotional Well-being
erc.text: We have been trusting Vocdoni for years because it offers us a secure, auditable and easy-to-use system that allows us to organise digital votes with all guarantees and adapted to the needs of our organisation.

granollers.text: At «Granollers Primàries» we understand digital participation as a key tool to expand and facilitate citizen participation. That is why we were looking for a platform that guaranteed neutrality, transparency and the highest security in voting processes. Vocdoni offers all of this, and that is why we chose it for our primaries and plan to continue using it in future consultations.

icoes.company: Official College of Nursing of Seville
icoes.text: Digitizing our voting with Vocdoni has made the entire electoral process more efficient. We have made participation much easier, especially for members who could not travel, while maintaining an agile and reliable system.

intersindical.text: At La Intersindical we believe that decisions affecting the entire teaching collective must be made by teachers themselves. That is why we needed a tool that guaranteed a transparent, neutral, and verifiable process. With Vocdoni we were able to bring this decision to nearly 100,000 professionals with the assurance that both the procedure and the result would be fully reliable.

omnium.text: At Òmnium Cultural we bet on a secure and verifiable voting system that would allow us to hold our statutory assemblies with all guarantees.

plataforma.text: Vocdoni lets us hold votes with members across all Catalan-speaking territories on equal terms. Instant counting simplifies our assemblies and ensures full transparency.

ustec.text: With Vocdoni we found a very good solution, being a neutral and verifiable infrastructure that guaranteed both the integrity of the count and the privacy of voters. This allowed every teacher to vote only once, securely and anonymously.
